name: Enkidu
subtitle: Companion of Kings
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Unique among all creatures, Enkidu’s soul was Shattered along with the world itself; refracted into nine separate “avatars” across the Realms, each a portion of the original. Now that he has been restored, the wild warrior struggles to process his experience, to regain his sense of self—and to forgive his beloved companion Gilgamesh for the horrors wrought in his name.
